description: Reveal content hidden behind a control on an open page (a tab, an expand toggle, a disclosure, a "more" button): Banquish clicks the candidate for you (or the one button or link inside it, when it holds just one), stopping any request that could write, any navigation and any new window meanwhile, and checks that new content appeared. Returns the updated tree in lines like open_page's: the new candidates, then the outline. Ids you had stay valid; new content gets new ids. A Panel made from the page afterwards comes back in the revealed view after a reload. If the click tries to navigate or open a window, moves the page to another path, or shows nothing new, the reveal is refused with the reason: use content reachable by URL instead. Never on the user's Private sites. Reveals on different pages may run in parallel.
name: reveal
